label: Home
about: Home tasks, a maintenance schedule, utilities, smart-home devices, home services and the household list.
approvals: Booking or paying a home service
Changing a smart-home device or home setting
Messaging a landlord, neighbour or tradesperson

routines.name: Maintenance calendar
routines.prompt: List the home maintenance due this month (filters, gutters, gas, service visits) from the saved schedule; stay silent if none.

routines.name: Utility bill reminder
routines.prompt: Remind the user of electricity, water and internet bills due before the month ends, with last month's amount for comparison.

routines.name: Leaving home checklist
routines.prompt: The user just left home. If they asked for a leaving checklist (stove, windows, lights, keys), show it in one line.
